name: Tipcapnerve
description: Stand poised with the staff high and slanted, one end watching like a hawk and the other low in reserve.

name: Sweepstep Wrath
description: Jab with the near end and let the far end follow along the same line a heartbeat behind.

name: Obdurate Whitewood
description: Brush an incoming strike aside as lightly as a feather turns the wind, the qi barely felt in the shaft.

name: Bostipglimmer
description: Shift along one track while the guard holds on the other, so movement never opens the body.

name: Blistering Spinbreak
description: Strike from both ends in quick succession, one to each side of the guard, pinching it between them.

name: Gyve Rightgrip
description: Lay the staff across the opponent's weapon and hold it in the pause between paired strokes.

name: Glint Staffcentre
description: Spread the guard like wings and cut down through the centre of the opponent's own opening.

name: Blockhavoc
description: Wheel the staff once to each side in matched turns, each wheel ending in a strike on its own flank.

name: Nova Roll
description: Send two qi-laden strokes from opposite ends at once, converging on the opponent's guard from above and below.

name: Unbudging Leftgrip
description: Hold the staff wide before the body like a basin's rim, open to the front but covering the sides.

name: Blaze Roundstaff
description: Jab at the point where the opponent's stance begins, sending the whole body's weight along the staff.

name: Bogrip Tenacity
description: Turn a blow from its path as a stream turns round a stone, never opposing it directly.

name: Mightpivot
description: Walk forward in slow paces that settle the ground and the mind, the staff held level like still water.

name: Pivotwrath
description: Rap the opponent's wrist with a looping flick of the tip, qi circling back to the hand after.

name: Gyve Balancenode
description: Catch the opponent's weapon on the shaft as it runs aground and hold it in the shallows of the guard.

name: Charter Block
description: Advance and press a little more with each step, the qi rising against the opponent like water in a basin.

name: Mighttipcap
description: Cut along a gently curving line that bends round the parry and finishes on the unguarded side.

name: Rollscourge
description: Surge forward in a wave of strikes that gives the opponent no pause, qi rising with every beat.

name: Septic Bostip
description: Soak a patch of ground with qi through the staff's end, so that a foot there sinks and slows.

name: Hellish Nova Pivot
description: Drive the staff through the opponent's stance along a single flowing line, scattering its balance as it goes.

name: Aegistipcap
description: Hold the staff level with a qi field lit at each end, the two courts ready to act together.

name: Vengeful Bogrip
description: Jab on the left track while the right end keeps the guard, never both ends striking at once.

name: Taperend Tenacity
description: Block on the right track with the near end while the left end draws back for the next strike.

name: Sweepstep Blink
description: Cross from the left track to the right in a single glide, the staff's ends trading roles midway.

name: Torrent Bostip
description: Swing the staff like a pair of doors, opening to let a blow pass and closing on its wielder's arm.

name: Blazeroll
description: Pivot on the lead foot so the far end swings round and strikes where the near end has just feinted.

name: Fastening Block
description: Hold the opponent's weapon between two qi fields, one at each end, so it can move on neither track.

name: Intent Staffcentre
description: Advance down both tracks together, guarding with one end and striking with the other at every step.

name: Pivotvalor
description: Swap guard and strike between the two ends at the instant of contact, shattering the opponent's timing.

name: Corroding Rightgrip
description: Bring both tracks to the same point so the guard is struck and held at the same moment.

name: Adamantine Whitewood
description: Hold the staff overhead and slant the body forward, watching the whole of the opponent's stance from above.

name: Granite Tipcap
description: Jab at the guard to make it rise, preparing the ground for the stoop that is to follow.

name: Bostipspine
description: Parry from above with the staff slanting downward so each blow is driven into the earth.

name: Granite Roll
description: Drop the rear heel in a falling step that sets the body firmly beneath the staff for the descent.

name: Might Roundstaff
description: Press the staff's end down onto the opponent's guard so that all their weight is driven to the ground.

name: Verity Tipcap
description: Fix the tip on the opponent's centre of weight and let the field hold that point like a hawk's eye.

name: Mighttipjab
description: Fall onto a downward cut with both arms and the weight of the body trailing the staff.

name: Bostipmettle
description: Clamp the staff across the opponent's weapon arm from above and bear down as a talon holds prey.

name: Shade Balancenode
description: Keep the staff raised over the opponent's head so that every move must be made under its threatened fall.

name: Devastating Taperend
description: Drop from the high guard in a single plunge, the staff's end driven through the centre of the opponent's guard.

name: Fastening Staffcentre
description: Circle the opponent from above with the staff held high, its field pressing on the opponent's own qi flow.

name: Facet Leftgrip
description: Plant the staff's end and spread a sovereign hold over the ground around it, slowing every foe who steps in.

name: Gnashing Pivot
description: Leap high, then plunge with the staff's end into the earth, so the qi from the strike surges outward across the ground.

name: Thornbogrip
description: Stand with elbows tucked and the staff held close and slanted, like wings folded before a dive.

name: Rumble Tipjab
description: Open the left wing of the staff in a jab, the near end drawing the guard to one side.

name: Granite Block
description: Open the right wing in a cut across the gap the left wing has made.

name: Torrential Spinbreak
description: Beat forward in two quick paces, the staff's ends rising and falling in time with each foot.

name: Whitewood Valor
description: Spread the staff like a sheltering wing over the body and let blows glide down its length.

name: Merciless Rightgrip
description: Flick the staff's tip at the opponent's eyes or hand, the strike stinging and drawing the guard.

name: Evergreen Balancenode
description: Throw the ends of the staff wide to part a double attack, then bring them back together.

name: Spinbreak Fortitude
description: Lock the opponent's two arms between the two ends of the staff and draw them together.

name: Tipcaphavoc
description: Sweep one end through the opponent's legs while stepping past on the other side to land behind them.

name: Tipjab Reckoning
description: Bring both wings down in turn, the second descent taking the place of the first as it recovers.

name: Wrathful Tipjab
description: Drive both ends in a scissor motion at the opponent's guard and shear it open along its weakest seam.

name: Dazzling Rumble Sweepstep
description: Beat both ends of the staff downward and vault across the gap in an instant, striking on landing.

name: Unrelenting Taperend
description: Hold the staff upright with one hand low and one high, a current of qi running down each arm.

name: Gnashing Bogrip
description: Jab against the opponent's own motion as a swimmer pushes against a stream, using their momentum.

name: Unconquered Tipcap
description: Slip a blow downstream by turning the staff with it and letting its force carry past the hip.

name: Granite Bostip
description: Meet a blow with both currents of qi at once, stiffening the shaft at the exact point of contact.

name: Tipjabhavoc
description: Sweep with both currents streaming from the staff, the lower one at the legs and the higher at the arms.

name: Ponderous Block
description: Spin the staff round the opponent's weapon in a tightening whirlpool until it is drawn off line.

name: Eviscerating Roll
description: Let the two currents join at the tip in one turn of the wrists and cut through the guard.

name: Ponderous Pivot
description: Surge forward with both currents behind the staff, a wall of qi pushing the opponent back step by step.

name: Unsparing Roundstaff
description: Whirl the staff to gather both currents and release them together in a broad outward blast of qi.

name: Granite Rightgrip
description: Hold the staff short with both hands close to the body, ready for strikes at elbow's distance.

name: Bogrip Wrath
description: Slide to the staff's end and jab from the longest reach to test the distance without committing.

name: Gust Roll
description: Slide the grip from near reach to far reach while stepping, so the opponent misjudges the distance.

name: Torrent Balancenode
description: Check a close strike with the staff held short against the forearm and turn it past the shoulder.

name: Gust Tipjab
description: Rap the opponent's nearest joint with a short sharp strike from inside, before their guard can reset.

name: Rumblebogrip
description: Cut from the staff's full reach at the weapon hand, spoiling a stroke before it begins.

name: Gyve Leftgrip
description: Trade near and far reach in a quick hand change that pins the opponent's weapon at the moment of crossing.

name: Hourbogrip
description: Strike from far reach, slide in, and strike from near reach with the same staff and the same breath.

name: Sweepstep Reckoning
description: Hold the opponent at the outer edge of the staff's field, denying every step inward with pressing strikes.

name: Tipcapdurance
description: Catch a strike with the near reach and return it to its source along the far reach.

name: Facetbogrip
description: Stand with the staff pointed on the sworn bearing, feet set across the wind and the oath held in the grip.

name: Rampaging Pivot
description: Jab along the sworn line so exactly that the strike cannot be called anything but straight.

name: Bogripmettle
description: Turn the shoulder into the wind and parry with the staff held slanted, the gust adding weight to the turn.

name: Gust Leftgrip
description: Stride so that the staff's tip never leaves the bearing, however the opponent moves around.

name: Thorn Bostip
description: Cross the staff on the bearing and meet a heavy blow, the sworn stance refusing to give a step.

name: Gyve Whitewood
description: Lay the shaft over the opponent's weapon on the bearing and hold it with the force of the oath.

name: Might Taperend
description: Sweep the staff low on a rising gust so the wind carries the end through the opponent's ankles.

name: Spinbreak Ruin
description: Advance with the wind behind the staff, holding the bearing and pressing the opponent steadily backward.

name: Mayhem Tipjab
description: Wait for the opponent to break the bearing with a lunge, then strike into the gap the lunge has opened.

name: Irontipcap
description: Drive the staff down the sworn bearing with the wind behind it, striking the opponent's own flow of qi as well.

name: Adamantine Roundstaff
description: Stand on an imagined plateau's edge with feet wide and the staff held across the body against the buffeting wind.

name: Tipcap Scourge
description: Jab toward the edge of the opponent's stance, aiming to push them to where they cannot step.

name: Roundstaff Mettle
description: Meet a strike with the staff turned into the wind and let the gust help carry the blow wide.

name: Silt Taperend
description: Step firmly over bare ground where the wind has swept all loose stone away, never lifting the feet high.

name: Ironblock
description: Rap the opponent's hand as the bearing shifts, the staff's tip arriving just as the wind changes.

name: Rightgrip Premonition
description: Extend the staff's field to feel for the edge of the opponent's reach and the ground behind them.

name: Intent Leftgrip
description: Press the opponent toward the edge with the staff laid against the chest, step following step.

name: Tempered Block
description: Hook the near end behind the opponent's lead leg and sweep it toward the drop.

name: Bogripdurance
description: Spin the staff and let the field spread like a sheet of wind in front of the body, turning small strikes.

name: Bogripscourge
description: Cut with the whole body so the force carries the opponent backward over the drop's lip.

name: Pivot Fortitude
description: Hook the opponent's arm with the staff and turn so their own weight carries them past the edge.

name: Daybreak Roll
description: Plant the staff and release a broad downdraught of qi across the ground that drives all near it back.

name: Bogripspine
description: Drift in small circles with the staff weaving a loose guard, offering no fixed point for an opponent to strike.

name: Sanguine Whitewood
description: Jab and move at once, the strike landing as the feet are already leaving the spot.

name: Equipoise Staffcentre
description: Let a blow slide past the staff as wind slides past a post, without stopping to meet it.

name: Vanishing Bostip
description: Rove round the opponent in a wide curve, striking from whichever side is open, never planting the feet.

name: Reverie Tipcap
description: Toss the staff's end to one side as if caught by a gust, then bring it back on the other.

name: Blazebogrip
description: Rap the opponent's hand and chase the retreating arm across open ground with follow-up taps.

name: Bogrip Ruin
description: Circle the opponent without pause, the staff's tip flicking in on every pass until they tire.

name: Mayhemroll
description: Strike the opponent's leading step just as it lifts, so balance fails where there is nothing to hold.

name: Unseen Spinbreak
description: Vanish from one bearing and arrive on another, the staff's tip already at the opponent's unguarded side.

name: Hoarfrost Staffcentre
description: Stand turned into the wind with the staff upright before the chest, the oath said silently on the breath.

name: Lacerating Spinbreak
description: Jab on the end of the spoken oath, so the breath and the stroke leave together.

name: Gust Roundstaff
description: Parry across the wind with the staff slanted so the incoming blow is carried toward the leeward side.

name: Granite Balancenode
description: Fall back to the leeward side in a single step, the staff held across to keep the opponent at the same length.

name: Might Bostip
description: Raise the staff and drop it with all of the oath's weight, the strike landing as one with the breath.

name: Aegis Bogrip
description: Block a strong blow with the oath held in the arms, refusing to yield even a hand's breadth.

name: Hoarfrost Whitewood
description: Pin the opponent's weapon to the sworn line and hold it there until the oath is satisfied.

name: Glint Leftgrip
description: Break the wind with a thrust that parts the air before it, the tip arriving whole and sharp.

name: Charter Pivot
description: Walk into the wind with the staff held ahead, pressing the opponent back with every sworn step.

name: Chime Taperend
description: Turn the opponent's blow back along its own line on the oath's turn and strike through the same opening.

name: Evergreen Charter Rightgrip
description: Break the pattern of an incoming technique with a single wind-struck rap, then strike at the opening.

name: Granite Staffcentre
description: Stand with the back to the drop and the staff held broad, guarding the one path to the edge.

name: Roll Reckoning
description: Jab from the side facing the drop, giving the opponent no room to dodge in that direction.

name: Chime Tipcap
description: Parry along the rim with the staff low, turning each attack away from the drop and the body.

name: Siltbogrip
description: Walk the plateau's rim in sure paces, the staff held out to the side as a balance beam.

name: Block Ruin
description: Time a rising cut to the updraft at the edge, adding the wind's lift to the stroke.

name: Waning Whitewood
description: Feel with the staff's field for the exact lip of the drop and for the opponent's footing near it.

name: Bostip Tenacity
description: Press the staff against the opponent's chest at the rim, pinning them with the drop at their back.

name: Iron Taperend
description: Sweep the opponent's front foot toward the drop, forcing a step they cannot afford to take.

name: Hour Spinbreak
description: Hold the line along the rim with the staff's field pressing, so that every move the opponent makes is cramped.

name: Hellish Tipjab
description: Shove the opponent with the staff's full length at the instant a gust pushes against them.

name: Maiming Block
description: Turn the exchange on the rim so the opponent finds the drop at their own back instead.

name: Slagroll
description: Whirl the staff on the rim and release a surge of wind-driven qi that thrusts back all who stand near.

name: Tipjabdurance
description: Strike the opponent at the rim so that the qi in their legs stalls and they cannot recover their footing.

name: Tipcapspine
description: Anchor the feet and point the staff's tip at a single mark, holding the bearing through gusts.

name: Ruinous Roundstaff
description: Jab from the anchored stance without shifting the shoulders, the strike coming from the arms alone.

name: Gust Staffcentre
description: Parry with the staff while the feet stay fixed, the turn carried wholly by the wrists and the wind.

name: Phantom Rightgrip
description: Step out to avoid a blow and step back at once to the same mark, restoring the bearing.

name: Tipcapmettle
description: Shift the qi field from front to side without moving the staff, so the guard changes while the line holds.

name: Devastating Roll
description: Strike at the mark the tip has held on all along, the blow landing exactly where the opponent fears.

name: Balancenode Spine
description: Lay the staff against the opponent's weapon and hold it steady on the bearing against all their strength.

name: Tipjabwrath
description: Drive forward down the held bearing in one straight stroke that the gale itself seems to carry.

name: Confluent Tipjab
description: Let the field change from a narrow spear to a broad sheet and back, striking in each form.

name: Impervious Bogrip
description: Hold the bearing against a great force and return its weight down the staff into a single piercing thrust.

name: Granite Leftgrip
description: Stand with the staff raised and the breath drawn in, as if gathering the whole plateau's wind into the shaft.

name: Balancenode Scourge
description: Open an exchange with a jab on the first gust, testing how the opponent meets the wind-driven point.

name: Unconquered Whitewood
description: Parry just as the wind stalls and let the stillness hold the blow away from the body.

name: Lightning Bogrip
description: Charge forward with the wind at the back, the staff's tip arriving well before the feet.

name: Sanguine Tipcap
description: Catch a gust at the top of the swing and let it add its weight to the downward cut.

name: Hourroll
description: Lay the staff on the opponent's guard and let the wind-gathered weight press slowly through it.

name: Tempered Sweepstep
description: Cut with the staff's edge turned to the wind so that it whistles and the stroke gathers speed.

name: Pivotnerve
description: Wrap the opponent's weapon in the wind-driven turn of the staff and draw it round to the side.

name: Mayhemtipcap
description: Sweep the staff in a wide flat circle, the gathered wind rushing outward across the ground.

name: Tipjabruin
description: Bring the staff down from overhead with the wind's full weight behind it, splitting the opponent's high guard.

name: Merciless Pivot
description: Gather the wind's weight over a long breath and bring it down in a single stroke that pins as it strikes.
